name: shittake lentil soup
instructions:
The clean lentil soup (formerly 'the clean version / variant A' of the dissolved mushroomed-lentils-british file — decided the best of that line). DARK STOCK + TOMATO backbone, SHIITAKE mushrooms, LIMITED FAT, LIMITED VEGETABLES outside of onion.

=== THE BUILD ===

- ONIONS + SHIITAKE MUSHROOMS + SPANISH PARDINA LENTILS (pivotal — they pair with the shiitakes).
- DARK BROTH + chunky whole TOMATO + TOMATO PASTE — the espagnole-style backbone. NO MARMITE.
- WORCESTERSHIRE: YES.
- LIMITED FAT — skipped the butter (and fat entirely) and it was fine.
- HERBS: FRESH ROSEMARY + THYME (not dried) + BAY LEAF.
- LIMITED VEGETABLES — no celery/carrot, no garlic; onion carries the aromatics.
- BLACK PEPPER. POTATO cut up inside.
- NO LEMON, NO CUMIN/SPICE.
- POSSIBLY BARLEY (want to try).

=== METHOD — INSTAPOT, 15 MINUTES ===

INSTAPOT, 15 MINUTES — the lentils and the BROTH EXTRACTION happen AT THE SAME TIME. Key to its success, along with the fresh-not-dried rosemary + thyme.
notes:
Split out 2026-10-31 from the dissolved mushroomed-lentils-british file, where it was 'the clean version' — decided the BEST of that line (beating both the Nisha wellington and the Jamie cottage-pie scaffold it shared the file with).

=== WHY IT WORKS ===

- SPANISH PARDINA LENTILS were PIVOTAL — they pair with the shiitakes.
- INSTAPOT (15 min) does the lentils and the broth extraction AT THE SAME TIME — key to its success.
- FRESH rosemary + thyme, not dried — also key.
- DARK STOCK + TOMATO (the espagnole combo) just goes great with mushrooms and potatoes — same backbone logic as [[french-beef-and-mushroom-stew]].

=== NO MARMITE — THE ANCHOR IS THE STOCK ===

The dark-anchor slot holds ONE thing: here it's the dark stock. MARMITE + DARK STOCK stacked is too much MSG (the lesson from [[pub-style-lentils]]'s marmite build, where marmite holds the slot and the stock is clashing instead). Marmite is clashing here on that basis.

=== LIMITED FAT, LIMITED VEGETABLES ===

Skipped the butter — and fat entirely — and it was FINE; fat is optional-to-limited here. Vegetables stay limited to the ONION (no celery, no carrot, no garlic) — the cleanness is the identity. The CHUNKY TOMATOES are THE BEST PART — both tomato forms are in (chunky whole tomato + tomato paste).

=== ROSEMARY NOTE (THE UNSOLVED RULE) ===

Rosemary rides happily against the dark-stock anchor here with NO celery/carrot in the pot — while the celery + tomato forward stews ([[creamy-french-lentils]], the retired italian mushroomed lentils) refuse it. Whether the mechanism is the dark anchor, 'something meaty', or the celery itself is UNSOLVED — [[chicken-pot-pie]] has celery AND rosemary happily, so no theory is clean yet.

=== WANT TO TRY ===

BARLEY — mushroom-barley territory; it fits the register.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[pub-style-lentils]]: the anchored pub sibling — the marmite + cumin + lemon build (Jamie Oliver's line, served with mash) and the ale + pickle build, merged into one recipe.
- [[creamy-french-lentils]]: the mustard + cream + potato stew.
- the retired italian mushroomed lentils is RETIRED — it was converging on this recipe anyway (dark broth + fresh tomato + shiitake) and wasn't going anywhere.
